evals.name: full-brief
evals.prompt: Set up a Wheelhouse called hq in ./hq (an empty git repository I have just created), for running my day: my mail, Slack and calendar. Crew are named after Beatles surnames (Lennon, McCartney, Harrison, Starr), workers after planets (Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter) and standing roles after Greek gods (Hermes, Athena, Apollo). Keep memory in ynm. No seats yet.
evals.expected_output: Creates ./hq as a git repository with: an AGENTS.md constitution naming its purpose (running the day: mail, Slack, calendar) and rules (a human decides; work in Beads and memory in ynm; claim as yourself; hand off; never falsify the record; refuse what is outside the charter; never change a shared checkout (work in your own git worktree in your scratchpad, never stash); name things fully: web resources by short form as a Markdown link, local paths absolute); a rule to ask a human through the inbox; a roster skill with the three pools as given and a humans list holding exactly one default human, named by the skill (suggested from the themes) with no email; a desk harness named hq including the wheelhouse plugin and carrying labels {"wheelhouse": "hq"} (an object, not an array); and a Beads graph started with --skip-agents and prefix hq, so no Beads agent setup. It runs ynm init and ynm client install ynh, adds no remote and pushes nothing, and asks the human to add the ynm push sync to the Beads pre-push hook rather than doing it unasked. It also writes wheelhouse.json at the root with tasks beads and memory ynm, and copies scripts/memory.sh beside wake.sh and inbox.sh.
assertions: The evidence shows ./hq is a git repository with at least one commit
AGENTS.md states the Wheelhouse's purpose (running the day: mail, Slack and calendar) and includes rules that a human decides (or merges and sends) and that work lives in Beads and memory in ynm

skills/roster/assets/roster.json has the crew pool Lennon, McCartney, Harrison, Starr, the workers pool Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and the standing pool Hermes, Athena, Apollo, and only the desk (command hq, harness ".") in seats
.agents/harness/plugin.json is a desk named hq that includes the wheelhouse plugin
The desk's hooks run scripts/wake.sh --seat hq at session start, and scripts/wake.sh --seat hq --end at session end, with a timeout
The desk's manifest has launch_focus wake and a wake focus
Beads is set up in ./hq with the prefix hq (its database is named hq), and the evidence shows no Beads agent setup (no BEGIN BEADS block, no .agents/skills/beads)
The stubbed calls include ynm init and ynm client install ynh
.ynm/config.json in the evidence has a sync block with auto true
git remote -v in the evidence shows no remote, and nothing was pushed
The reply tells the human about the ynm push sync for the Beads pre-push hook (as a step for them, or offered), and the hook was not changed unasked

AGENTS.md has a rule never to change a shared checkout (no switching branches, checking out, committing, resetting or stashing there): work in your own git worktree in the scratchpad, and never use git stash
AGENTS.md has a section saying how finished work is handed over for review (uncommitted in the working tree, or a draft pull request), and that a human merges or commits
The desk's .agents/harness/plugin.json includes ynh's own skills from https://github.com/eyelock/ynh, picking skills/ynh-compose and skills/ynh-troubleshoot
The reply ends by offering the first role of the starter team, one seat at a time

AGENTS.md has a rule to name things fully, with both parts and an example of each: a web resource (such as a pull request) by its short form as a Markdown link, never a bare number or URL; and a local path in full (absolute), not relative
skills/roster/assets/roster.json has a humans list, separate from seats, with exactly one entry marked "default": true, that entry has a name and a command and no email, and no human appears in seats

AGENTS.md has a rule to ask a human through the inbox: when work needs a human (such as a merge, a decision or a credential), assign them a bead, the default human unless the seat knows who, and tell them things with an inbox note

AGENTS.md's desk section says that when a person names themselves at the desk ("it's me, <name>"), the desk shows their own inbox for that session with the inbox script's show --name, and registers nothing
The reply names the default human
wheelhouse.json in the evidence is {"tasks": "beads", "memory": "ynm"} and scripts/memory.sh is present beside wake.sh and inbox.sh

evals.name: thin-brief
evals.expected_output: Asks one question first: what the Wheelhouse is for (the space and its purpose). Creates nothing yet.
assertions: The reply asks what the Wheelhouse is for, or what space of work it covers
The reply asks one question, not a list of questions
The evidence shows no ./hq folder and no other Wheelhouse was created (no AGENTS.md, roster or .beads written)
The stubbed calls include no ynm init

evals.name: no-themes
evals.prompt: Set up a Wheelhouse called hq in a new folder ./hq, for running my day: my mail, Slack and calendar. No seats yet.
evals.expected_output: Has the purpose, name and reach, but no naming pools. Asks the human for the naming themes (crew, workers, standing roles) rather than choosing them, and creates nothing until it has them (or creates only what doesn't need them, with no invented pool).
assertions: The reply asks the human for the naming pools or themes
If skills/roster/assets/roster.json exists in the evidence, its pools contain no names or themes the human did not give
The reply does not present invented themes as decided (suggestions offered for the human to choose are fine)
The stubbed calls include no ynm init, or the reply explains it is waiting on the pools before finishing

evals.name: dirty-folder
evals.prompt: Set up a Wheelhouse called hq in a new folder ./hq, for running my day: my mail, Slack and calendar. Crew are named after Beatles surnames (Lennon, McCartney, Harrison, Starr), workers after planets (Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter) and standing roles after Greek gods (Hermes, Athena, Apollo). No seats yet.
evals.expected_output: Finds ./hq already exists as a git repository with an uncommitted file (notes.txt, which is personal). Stops and asks before going on, because bd init would commit it. notes.txt is not committed.
assertions: The evidence shows notes.txt was never committed: it is not in any commit in git log --stat, and is still untracked (or untouched)
The reply says ./hq already exists, or is not empty, or has uncommitted changes, naming notes.txt or the uncommitted file
The reply asks the human how to go on (another folder, or what to do with notes.txt) rather than going ahead
Beads was not initialised in ./hq (no .beads in the evidence), or it was initialised only after notes.txt was moved out of the way with the human's say-so

evals.name: shares-through-origin
evals.prompt: Set up a Wheelhouse called hq in ./hq, which I have just cloned from a new, empty GitHub repository, for running my day: my mail, Slack and calendar. Crew are named after Beatles surnames (Lennon, McCartney, Harrison, Starr), workers after planets (Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter) and standing roles after Greek gods (Hermes, Athena, Apollo). No seats yet.
evals.expected_output: Creates the Wheelhouse in ./hq as in the full brief. Since the repository has a remote, it shares the work graph through it: the Beads Dolt remote is the repository's own origin, with dolt.auto-push on and .beads/config.yaml committed. It publishes nothing unasked: no git push and no bd dolt push, and asks before the first push. The report says how to join from another machine: clone, bd bootstrap and ynm sync.
assertions: The evidence shows ./hq is a git repository with at least one commit, with Beads set up and the prefix hq
bd dolt remote list in the evidence shows origin pointing at the same repository as git's origin
bd config get dolt.auto-push in the evidence shows true
Nothing reached the remote: the evidence of what reached .eval/origin.git shows nothing
The reply asks before the first push of the work graph (or of the repository), rather than saying it pushed
The reply says how to join from another machine, including git clone, bd bootstrap and ynm sync

evals.prompt: Set up a Wheelhouse called hq in ./hq (an empty git repository I have just created), for running my day: my mail, Slack and calendar. Crew are named after Beatles surnames (Lennon, McCartney, Harrison, Starr), workers after planets (Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter) and standing roles after Greek gods (Hermes, Athena, Apollo). Agent Tasks in Beads, and Agent Memory in Beads too: no ynm. No seats yet.
evals.expected_output: Creates ./hq as in the full brief, with memory in Beads: wheelhouse.json at the root holds tasks beads and memory beads, scripts/memory.sh is copied beside wake.sh and inbox.sh, and AGENTS.md rule 2 says work and memory live in Beads, with memory read and written through scripts/memory.sh. It runs no ynm init and no ynm client install ynh, writes no .ynm/config.json, and does not ask for the ynm push sync. It runs the doctor, which reports no errors.
assertions: wheelhouse.json in the evidence is {"tasks": "beads", "memory": "beads"}
scripts/memory.sh is present in ./hq beside scripts/wake.sh and scripts/inbox.sh
AGENTS.md's second rule says work and memory live in Beads and that memory goes through scripts/memory.sh; it does not say memory lives in ynm
The stubbed calls include no ynm init and no ynm client install ynh, and the evidence shows no .ynm/config.json
The reply does not ask the human to add the ynm push sync to the Beads pre-push hook
Beads is set up in ./hq with the prefix hq, and the evidence shows no Beads agent setup (no BEGIN BEADS block, no .agents/skills/beads)
The reply reports the doctor's verdict with no errors, and says nothing was edited by hand to get there
git remote -v in the evidence shows no remote, and nothing was pushed
